subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which diagnostics-otel default bucket policy should OpenClaw ship for existing exported metrics before either overlapping PR merges?
rationale: The code mechanism is plausible, but this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098 intentionally change exported metric aggregation with different scopes and bucket ranges, which is a maintainer-owned observability compatibility decision.

options.title: Resolve overlap, then require proof
options.body: Choose the intended narrow or broad bucket policy first, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof before merge.

options.title: Accept this narrow policy
options.body: Merge this branch's run, harness, and context-token policy after accepting the dashboard/alert compatibility impact and receiving real export proof.

options.title: Use the broader related policy
options.body: Prefer the related PR's all-duration-metric policy if consistency across duration histograms matters more than this PR's narrower scope and longer run buckets.

recommendation.title: Resolve overlap, then require proof
recommendation.body: Choose the intended narrow or broad bucket policy first, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof before merge.
